tools.name: bulk_read
tools.description: Reads multiple or large files and answers a targeted question using a cheap, fast worker model (e.g. Gemini Flash, Groq, Ollama). Saves ~90% tokens by returning only structured bullet points.

question.description: The specific question to answer about the files

file_paths.description: List of file paths to analyze

model.description: Optional model override (or 'auto' to select the best available reader model)

provider.description: Optional provider override (gemini, groq, openai, deepseek, anthropic, ollama, openrouter)

tools.name: code_write
tools.description: Generates boilerplate code (tests, mocks, stubs, configs) matching the patterns of a reference file. Can write directly to disk without consuming frontier output tokens.

spec.description: Description of what code to generate

reference_path.description: Path to reference file whose conventions, style, and structure should be replicated

target_path.description: Optional path where generated code should be written directly on disk

model.description: Optional model override (or 'auto' to select the best available writer model)

provider.description: Optional provider override (gemini, groq, openai, deepseek, anthropic, ollama, openrouter)

tools.name: get_available_models
tools.description: Discovers active models from the worker provider and recommends the best model for reading (high context / low cost) and writing (code intelligence). Enables calling agents to delegate dynamically to the best model.

provider.description: Optional provider to query (gemini, groq, openai, deepseek, anthropic, ollama, openrouter). Defaults to active provider.
